en: Sepia-toned photograph of a tall, cylindrical medieval stone tower standing on a raised fortification or castle wall. The tower has a crenellated top with a flagpole and flag. Behind and to the right is a long, rectangular building forming part of the same defensive complex. Trees frame the scene on the left and right, and a park-like area with paths and benches occupies the foreground. The overall style and wear suggest an early 20th‑century postcard. No visible printed caption or back text is present in the image area shown.
